text:
taylor: FYI our onboarding sample-app publish failed in the release pipeline after the codegen regen landed. this is blocking the quickstart demo for new signups. error from the publish job:
```
> npm publish --access public
ERR! Version mismatch: package.json (1.0.1) vs git tag (1.0.2)
ERR! Aborting publish.
```
noah: ugh. that usually happens if the release script bumped package.json but the tag is from a different PR. which PR changed the openapi?

ravi: PR #829 tightened `search` schema (optional -> required) so typegen changed the Go client signature: `SearchPrefix *string` -> `SearchPrefix string`. go SDK tests started failing on sample-app because they relied on nil semantics.

lexi: did we update changelog with a BREAKING CHANGE? our publish check runs `lint:changelog` and fails the pipeline if missing. I saw the changelog entry but no BREAKING section. CI logs show both typegen diff and changelog lint error.

ci-bot: [build 9102] FAILURE on release/sample-app - typegen/regenerate + lint:changelog failed. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/9102 :x:

noah: choices: revert the openapi change (if accidental), ship a semver-major for the sample-app and SDK (1.x -> 2.0.0) with migration notes, or add a compatibility layer in Go client to accept empty string and treat it as nil.

taylor: for onboarding UX I prefer not to leave sample-app broken. can we do a patch release for sample-app (keep openapi change) and add a small shim in the Go client to accept pointer->value transition? then do a major for the SDK later with full cleanup.

ravi: i can add a temporary unexported helper: `func normalizePrefix(p string) *string { if p=="" { return nil } ; return &p }` and adjust generated wrapper to call it. but that means committing a manual edit into a generated file which is lame. alternatively we can adjust the generator config to emit `*string` for now.

lexi: generator config change is better. but we need to ensure typegen output is stable across node versions. remember last time node18 vs node20 produced different formatting leading to spurious diffs. let's pin the CI typegen action to node 18 for this branch to match our release runner.

noah: also update changelog: add `BREAKING CHANGES` subsection with example migration snippet for Go and note that sample-app will be patched. CI will accept after that.

ci-bot: queued build 9105 after push by taylor (branch: fix/sampleapp-publish).

taylor: pushed PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release/pull/433 - includes: generator config tweak to preserve pointers for string fields, changelog addition with BREAKING CHANGES and migration example, and bump sample-app package.json to 1.0.2 to match tag. requested review from @ravi @lexi. :rocket:

ravi: i'll run the local typegen matrix (node 18/20) and confirm no diffs. if good i'll approve.

lexi: once merged i'll request release-engineering to do a hotfix publish so new signups get a working quickstart. we should also add a small test in the sample-app CI that runs the binary with the old-nil-case to catch regressions.

noah: one more follow-up: can we add a pre-publish check that verifies package.json version == git tag? it would fail fast and avoid silent mismatches. i've opened issue 1214 to track automation.

ci-bot: [build 9105] SUCCESS - typegen/regenerate + lint:changelog passed. artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/9105/artifacts :white_check_mark:
